scope: Bounded Stage 4 faculty review for the nine routes newly advanced by Stage 3 re-entry 17. Eight leads clear the current-appointment, exact-program supervision, strong TerraProbe/Evidex overlap, and recent-work gates. EDISS deliberately has no retained lead because its main thesis supervisor comes from the student's later-selected second-year institution, which is not fixed at application time. Four additional current-roster candidates per route are encoded in professor_mapping.py and remain unscored unless they clear every evidence gate.
